services.title: UltraClean Conveyors
services.text: Our patented Flat Bed Conveyor is the preferred USDA accepted conveyor on the market, and UltraClean conveyors come as single units or complete systems.
points: Assemble and disassemble in minutes without tools
Built to 3A, USDA or FDA standards
Beds, frames and end rollers fabricated with 304 stainless steel
Fully seal welded to eliminate laminated surfaces and reduce contamination growth
Through holes are welded sleeves to prevent internal contamination
Available in custom specifications and a wide variety of industry-approved belting

about.title: Sanitary equipment from one Houston shop since 1977
text: Since 1977 our Houston facility has developed sanitary equipment and processes designed to meet USDA, FDA, 3-A and AMI standards, and we are American made and family owned.

We are on the north side of Houston, within 15 minutes of IAH airport, with 25,000 square feet of manufacturing space, 15,000 of it under three 5 ton overhead cranes, and lift truck capability of 3000 pounds indoors or outdoors.

A full-time service field crew handles work on-site, our shop is equipped for logistics and freight pickups, and we serve oil and gas production firms as well as food service manufacturers and packers.
about.imageAlt: The Sani-Weld, Inc. sign over the gate at the Isom Street shop

facts.heading: Request a Quote
facts.text: Tell us about yourself and your organization and one of our sales representatives will contact you as soon as possible. We protect your privacy: we do not sell or distribute contact information, and it is used only to better serve your business needs.

facts.heading: Installation
facts.text: Our service experts install our systems on-site with minimal interruption to your production line. We install complete systems, modify your existing system with our conveyors and machines, or retrofit existing systems with UltraClean parts and conveyor accessories.

facts.heading: Food Industry Products
items: Our patented Flat Bed Conveyor is the preferred USDA accepted conveyor on the market
Electropolished sanitary surfaces have been proven to reduce contamination
Our dual case washer is unique to the beverages and dairy industries
facts.text: Pathogens are a significant public health problem for food processors, and can be particularly problematic in food handling equipment. Our UltraClean line of conveyors and electropolished products lets you clean your production line more quickly and thoroughly and promotes a contamination-free environment for your product.

facts.heading: Oil and Gas Industry
facts.text: All oil and gas processing products are fabricated to customer specifications. Bring us your design or let our design engineers create the solution, whether in our shop, at your facility or on the job site.

facts.heading: Clean Room Industry
facts.text: All clean room products are custom fabricated to customer specifications.

facts.heading: Racing
facts.text: At Sani-Weld, we like to play as hard as we work. The father and son racing team of Doug and Neil Manchester has run local tracks for more than ten years and consistently finishes in the top five, whether in the Bomber, Street Stock, Late Model or UMP Modified divisions. With one bomber championship under their belts, you can catch the Sani-Weld racing team at 105 Speedway or Gator Speedway.
